digest.component_or_area: code-review gate / LLM runner model routing
propositions: Code-review gate declares model class on five LLM-calling steps (base, docs, tests, verify, coach) but every declaration is silently ignored at runtime, falling through to cfg.model instead
PydanticAIRunner.run discards req.config.model and resolves models only from its constructor-provided self._config, making per-step model overrides ineffective
Step identity and declared model class token are not threaded through usage logging, making per-step attribution impossible from recorded REBAR_USAGE_LOG output
Both single-shot prompt steps and batch steps correctly compute per-step model values upstream, but those values never reach the runner because the runner ignores what is handed to it

The fix requires threading step id and raw declared class token via ContextVar to both runner.py resolution point and usage_log.record, and substituting req.config.model into the effective config used for resolution
